tasks.details: Gate: flutter analyze clean; flutter test 143 passing (132 -> 143); scripts/build_web.sh succeeded with 'OK: web_plugin_registrant.dart registers all 13 web plugins'. TDD: test/release_version_test.dart (2 red -> green) pins v1.0.0 across pubspec, Gradle, and the changelog; test/secret_scan_config_test.dart (5 red -> green) pins the Gitleaks allowlist narrow. CI initially failed: Gitleaks reported 5 gcp-api-key findings in lib/firebase_options.dart because PR scans cover every commit in the range while pushes only scan their own diff. Those are public FlutterFire client keys, already classified low-sensitivity in the threat model, so gitleaks.toml allowlists only AIza-shaped values in that one generated file with useDefault=true; GITLEAKS_CONFIG wired into security-ci.yml. Both checks then passed and PR #6 merged as c155c80 (merge commit, D4). Annotated tag v1.0.0 pushed; no v1.0.0 tag had ever existed, so the changelog's 1.0.0 - 2026-07-16 heading was consolidated into one dated 1.0.0 release (D3). D5: unrouted ScanPage kept.
